title: Golf ball bounces off the reactor's field

tellings.quote: he was showing me the field on it and he said "Check this out." and took a golf ball and you know, intending to hit the reactor and instead it it bounced off the field and then hit a ceiling tile
he describes a basketball siiz maybe a smaller maybe soccer ball sized is um item
tellings.difference: Told second hand by Blitch, who describes a basketball- or soccer-ball-sized repelling item and does not mention the golf ball.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about Lazar's account at S4 of a reactor field that pushed objects away; here Blitch retells it.

plain: In the late 1980s, at a secret Nevada site called S4, a co-worker showed Bob Lazar the field around the power source of an alien craft, which Lazar calls the reactor. To show it off, the co-worker took a golf ball and tried to hit the reactor with it, and the ball bounced off the field and hit a ceiling tile. Lazar tells this first-hand and names Barry Castilio and Dennis Mariani in the telling. A former DARPA scientist named John Blitch passes on a version he heard from Lazar. DARPA is the Pentagon's advanced research agency. Blitch's version describes an object the size of a basketball or soccer ball that pushed things away, and it says nothing of a golf ball.
